title: Greets Mole and Offers Boat Ride
description: Greeted Mole, offered a boat ride on the river.

title: Introduces Mole to Toad and His Caravan
description: Introduced Mole to Toad, who showed off his new caravan.

title: Discourages Mole from Meeting Badger
description: Repeatedly discouraged Mole from meeting Badger, emphasizing Badger's solitude and dislike for visitors.

title: Seeks Shelter with Mole in the Wild Wood
description: Sought shelter from a snowstorm along with Mole and knocked on Badger's door for help.

title: Returns Home After Exploring
description: Returned home after a day out hunting and exploring with Mole, despite Mole's urgent plea to stop.

title: Helps Remove Toad’s Motor-Clothes
description: Helped forcibly remove Toad's motor-clothing after he refused.

title: Decides to Search for Portly
description: Decided to search for Otter’s missing son, Portly, by boat along the river during a moonlit night.

title: Rescues Toad from Canal
description: Rescued Toad from a canal, pulled him out of a hole he fell into.

title: Observes Migration and Hibernation Preparations
description: Observed field mice preparing for winter and swallows planning their migration route.

title: Informs Toad About Hall Takeover
description: Informed Toad about the takeover of Toad Hall by Stoats and Weasels.

title: Scolds Toad for Foolish Behavior
description: Scolded Toad for his foolish behavior after rescuing him from a canal.

title: Outfits Mole, Badger and Toad with Weapons
description: Ouftitted Mole, Badger, and Toad with weapons for an expedition to reclaim Toad Hall.
